results.caption:
“I’m not running away from anything. I’m running with it.” 🎙️

Dancer, creator, and marathon runner Austyn Farrell joined Ben and Anya - days after racing a sub-3 marathon in London - for one of the most powerful conversations we’ve had on The Runna Podcast. 

He shares everything: from rock bottom to finding running, sobriety, and a community where he truly belongs.

#runnapodcast #running

results.transcript: When people say you inspired me to run, that's the f***ing winner right there. Can running transform your life? This week we sat down with dancer, creator, marathon runner and icon Austin Farrell. Listen, every time I run past a steel drum, something happens to me. You get a vibe, don't you? From drinking, smoking and partying and struggling with his mental health to running marathons and inspiring others to do the same. I've run three marathons. Ask me that a year and a half ago. I would have been like, are you joking? I'm not doing one 10k run. He shares how running has given him purpose and how he's found true belonging as a queer man in the running world. You are who you are. Own it. Seeing so many other queer people is so incredible. All the colours, all the vibes. Listen now on The Runner Podcast.

results.transcript: Come with me to do a solo run. There's a route that I know nearby to here that I've done once with some friends. So I think I'm just going to do that route again because it was really nice. If you've been following me for a while, you'd know that I did my first ever half marathon a couple of months ago. And because I loved it so much, I decided that I'm going to do another half marathon in September. And it's the Nike Women's After Dark Tour. And I'm super excited because I'm actually partnering with Nike for this half marathon. The last half marathon, I think I posted like 22 times, which was like a crazy amount in one day. But it was so much fun. So I think I might be on that for this one as well. Yesterday, I went to the Nike seating suite and I picked up some really cute running outfits or just training outfits. This is one of them. It's my favorite color, green. For the actual race day, the colorway is going to be pink. So it's going to be girly to match the whole girls half marathon vibe. I feel like it's going to be really cutesy. So I think for tonight's run, I'm going to aim for 5Ks. I like this route because it goes along this river. I don't know if it's Parramatta River. It might be, actually. I think it is. I think my goal for this race is to mainly just have fun with it. Because I feel like when you have fun, there's no pressure. And you can enjoy the experience rather than feeling disappointed if you didn't reach a certain goal. However, in saying that, I guess if I can beat my time from last time, that would be amazing. For my last race, I finished it at about 2 hours and 7 minutes, which I was super happy with. But being completely honest, I didn't train as hard as what I could have because I was traveling constantly. And I just wasn't as locked in. But I'll try a bit harder. I'm actually really excited to see what I'm capable of when I actually do put in a bit more work. Some parts of this run are so dark. They should have a few more lights here, I think. But that's right. I've got my whistle. I've got my whistle. And I've got my reflectors on me. I've heard that the previous Nike After Dark race was full of thousands of women. There was DJs, other performances as well. And the atmosphere was just amazing. And I'd love to be able to just take that in and enjoy it rather than just feeling like I'm having to survive during the run. So I definitely think the extra training this time will be really helpful and get me through so I can just have fun with it. I'm at 3km now, so I've turned back to go back to the car because I think I went a little bit far. Also, this is my first time running with a running jacket and I'm loving it because it's really chilly in the air. But I'm not feeling cold and it's also not making me sweat too much. Like I don't feel overheated, which is great. Shoes are so cushiony and comfy too. Yes, we have some light now. Let's go. I'm at 4km. Feeling good. I love seeing the buildings lit up at night. It's such a vibe. Looks like I'm in the city. This is the river. It's so nice. Okay, I'm almost at 5km now. Gonna speed it up a little bit for the last 40 metres and then I'll stop. The trick is apparently you do shorter strides but faster when you want to speed up. So you're not using as much energy but you're still going at a faster pace. That's what I did towards the end of my last half an hour and it actually worked. 5km is done. Let's go. If you're going to be doing this half marathon as well, let me know in the comments what your personal goal is going to be. Whether it be crossing the finish line, setting yourself a PB, having fun with your friends, whatever. It would be really cool to like build a community and just keep each other accountable for the next few months. So I'm going to keep you guys in the loop and give you guys updates on my training and we're going to get through it together. I'm super excited. And remember the main thing is to just have fun with it. So let's go.
